I posted this in old FPH so some may remember this but:

I moved to smallish town in 2nd grade and had the usual trouble making friends. Eventually I became friends with the girl across the street, something of a social outcast at the time as well. We spent our summers wandering the woods on the outskirts, climbing trees, building forts, etc. After a year we were inseparable and we remained that way for a long time.

Around middle school my friend started putting on weight. She maxed out around 50lbs over what would be considered healthy- not immobile or anything but clearly unhealthy. Suddenly she didn't want to go on hikes with me anymore, she would rather stay in and watch movies/eat pizza. Sometimes I would stay in with her, I like movies and pizza too, but I found other people to explore the outdoors with. My friend and I remained close, I honestly didn't think much of it.

In high school I had a series of girlfriends, all of whom were thin and active. My friend acted strangely around them, eventually she told me she had feelings for me. I told her I didn't feel the same way and she got quiet about it again. Typical of teenage boys, I was just happy I didn't have to explain why and I went about my business. Each time a girlfriend and I broke up she would remind of those feelings, though. Each time I would gently tell her I didn't feel the same way. We were still close, we had wonderful conversations and shared a lot of fond memories. I just wasn't attracted to her.

Prom came. It became clear that my friend viewed prom as 'the night' for us. The stars had aligned- I was single, we were older, 'more mature.' I found out later she had struggled to find a fitting dress, that she ended up making one for herself with her mom. This all happened without me knowing, though, and by the time she asked me I had made plans with a group of friends to camp out over that weekend. I told her as much and she avoided me for weeks after.

As college plans were made I looked forward to moving from my little town. My friend, who had been a little distant ever since prom, approached again and asked what I thought about her moving to the same city as me. Maybe we could be roommates, explore a new place together. It sounded like a fine idea to me, but I warned her that it would only be as friends. In the end, she didn't come.

I know this isn't a typical rejection story, but when I think back I see that she and I were compatible in so many ways. We might have been amazing together. After high school, I left town, went to college, and eventually met my wife. We travel and explore. My friend stayed in town, settled down with a chubby guy and had a couple of chubby kids. They seem happy enough, from their pictures, but I'm already seeing those little posts about back aches and knee pains. Two roads, I suppose.
